changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE "${schema}".employee ADD CONSTRAINT uq_import_employee_tenant UNIQUE(tenant_id,id); ALTER TABLE "${schema}"."user" ADD CONSTRAINT uq_import_user_tenant UNIQUE(tenant_id,id); ALTER TABLE "${schema}".salary_component ADD COLUMN show_on_payslip BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE; UPDATE "${schema}".salary_component SET show_on_payslip=FALSE WHERE type='EMPLOYER_CONTRIBUTION'; ALTER TABLE "${schema}".employee_salary_structure ADD COLUMN annual_gross NUMERIC(18,2) CHECK(annual_gross >= 0); ALTER TABLE "${schema}".employee_salary_structure ADD COLUMN annual_employer_pf NUMERIC(18,2) CHECK(annual_employer_pf >= 0); CREATE TABLE "${schema}".employee_payroll_rule ( tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, employee_id UUID NOT NULL, rules JSONB NOT NULL, effective_from DATE NOT NULL, updated_by UUID NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,employee_id,effective_from), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,employee_id) REFERENCES "${schema}".employee(tenant_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,updated_by) REFERENCES "${schema}"."user"(tenant_id,id) ); CREATE TABLE "${schema}".payroll_period_input ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, employee_id UUID NOT NULL, year INT NOT NULL CHECK(year BETWEEN 1900 AND 2200), month INT NOT NULL CHECK(month BETWEEN 1 AND 12), input JSONB NOT NULL, ready BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, source_ref JSONB, revision INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision > 0), updated_by UUID NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), UNIQUE(tenant_id,employee_id,year,month), UNIQUE(tenant_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,employee_id) REFERENCES "${schema}".employee(tenant_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,updated_by) REFERENCES "${schema}"."user"(tenant_id,id) ); CREATE TABLE "${schema}".payroll_period_adjustment ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, employee_id UUID NOT NULL, year INT NOT NULL CHECK(year BETWEEN 1900 AND 2200), month INT NOT NULL CHECK(month BETWEEN 1 AND 12), code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK(amount >= 0), reason TEXT, ready BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, updated_by UUID NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), UNIQUE(tenant_id,employee_id,year,month,code), CHECK(NOT ready OR amount=0 OR LENGTH(BTRIM(COALESCE(reason,''))) > 0), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,employee_id) REFERENCES "${schema}".employee(tenant_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,updated_by) REFERENCES "${schema}"."user"(tenant_id,id) ); CREATE TABLE "${schema}".payslip_statement ( payslip_id UUID PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, statement JSONB NOT NULL, period_input_id UUID, period_input_revision INT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,payslip_id) REFERENCES "${schema}".payslip(tenant_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,period_input_id) REFERENCES "${schema}".payroll_period_input(tenant_id,id) ); CREATE TABLE "${schema}".payroll_period_input_audit ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, period_input_id UUID NOT NULL, revision INT NOT NULL, input JSONB NOT NULL, changed_by UUID NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), UNIQUE(period_input_id,revision), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,changed_by) REFERENCES "${schema}"."user"(tenant_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,period_input_id) REFERENCES "${schema}".payroll_period_input(tenant_id,id) );
